5448bd180ebda2a99555318853cc81f1bdd50f83.summary: Malpedia entry, compiled by Fraunhofer FKIE, on the CHINACHOPPER malware family: a code injection webshell that runs Microsoft .NET code sent in HTTP POST requests, allowing file transfer, command execution, and access to Active Directory and databases. It lists six actor names and a bibliography of vendor and government reports from 2013 to 2025. The page notes that no YARA signature exists yet.

54e84f877ecf6fe1002d484bdf32634d394bc293.summary: ReliaQuest reports an October 2024 intrusion at a manufacturing customer, attributed with high confidence to Scattered Spider, an English-speaking collective acting as an affiliate of the RansomHub ransomware group. The attacker socially engineered the help desk twice to reset accounts, created a virtual machine on the ESXi host to evade EDR, encrypted systems within about six hours, and exfiltrated data. The report also covers Scattered Spider's history with ALPHV and how ransomware affiliates use English-speaking social engineers.
